title: Add remux fallback pilot promotion command
summary: Add a backend-owned 3-pilot remux fallback promotion command for exact current-queue per-file remux overrides.
reason: Operators need a bounded way to apply the already-proven oversized encode fallback behavior across a long current TV queue without creating future folder or show rules.
behavior_before: Operators could apply file overrides one row at a time or use the existing current-series override flow, but there was no backend evidence gate for promoting a proven oversized-encode remux fallback across the remaining current queue rows.
behavior_after: A confirmed Local API command validates exactly three same-series completed pilot rows with oversized-encode remux fallback evidence, then runs the existing current-series preview machinery and writes exact current-queue remux overrides while protecting exact manual overrides.
